review_kind: semantic classification contract, deterministic helper and source qualification

findings.observation: The agent classifies original request meaning before translation, handles English/Russian defect terms and issuee, and excludes negations and new issue/bug-classifier features. The helper validates a defect/other decision with a reason and retains provenance in the Pending body.
The helper uses all parsed open queues, includes blocked tasks, ignores terminal history, uses default 100 only for an empty maximum, and honors explicit numeric/relative/low defect priority.

Existing programmatic payloads retain previous defaults; classified ordinary requests retain relationship rules. Invalid decisions/relative conflicts fail before writes. Installed packages execute independently across all flavors.

Early synthetic prioritized fixtures lacked required provenance and structured task sections. Corrected fixtures establish a controlled baseline with 10 behavioral failures and zero fixture errors, followed by 13 passing tests.

limitations: Semantic interpretation remains an agent responsibility; deterministic fixtures do not establish actual agent/model adherence.
No live Git provider publication, product, Figma or paid-model operation ran.
